views.name: houses
views.def:
SELECT buildings.name AS building_name,
    properties.name_or_number AS property_name_or_number,
    streets.name AS street_name,
    streets.id AS street_id,
    buildings.id AS building_id,
    properties.id AS property_id,
    buildings.floors
   FROM smart_comment_relations.properties
     JOIN smart_comment_relations.streets ON properties.street_id = streets.id
     LEFT JOIN smart_comment_relations.buildings ON buildings.property_id = properties.id AND buildings.is_primary IS TRUE;
